brief:
Mohammed Saad kneels amid pulverized concrete in Beit Lahia, carefully brushing dust from the spine of a weathered novel. The salvage effort, documented in a project called "Al-Makshouf," focuses on rescuing Gaza's cultural heritage from destruction across the territory, the Palestine News Network reported.

Palestinians are retrieving rare books and traditional crafts from the rubble as part of efforts to preserve their cultural legacy amid widespread devastation. The initiative represents an attempt to recover tangible pieces of Palestinian identity and history from damaged homes and neighborhoods.
dek: DEIR AL-BALAH/ Gaza Strip Kneeling amidst the pulverized concrete of what was once a quiet street in Beit Lahia, Mohammed Saad carefully brushes gray dust off the spine of a weathered novel.
title: Palestinians rescue rare books and heritage crafts from Gaza's rubble
